revision_scope.rule: Apply only the minimum changes required by the independent V3 review before D2/D3, plus B1N3-05 because that review explicitly lists it as required before D2. Preserve all other nonblocking findings without accidental closure.

pre_step_gate.rule: The recorded snapshot is provenance only. Re-read every live repository/platform value at each future D gate. Any drift is evaluated before authority; no recorded value is execution authority.

trusted_required_job_invariants.drift_rule: Any new filter/if/dependent-job skip path affecting the required job is class-D design drift => STOP and independent review.

exact_future_messages.D1_PUSH_POSITIVE: test: add R2 B1 push collision positive control
exact_future_messages.D2_PUSH_SENTINEL: test: trigger R2 B1 push collision negative sentinel
exact_future_messages.D2_PR_COLLISION: test: add R2 B1 pull request collision negative

commit_message_control.pre_write_rule: Before every probe commit/write, obtain the full exact commit message that GitHub will record, normalize only for the search, and reject if any forbidden token/sub-string appears. The literal message is then stored verbatim as evidence.
commit_message_control.push_range_rule: For every branch update, enumerate every newly introduced commit and store each full message verbatim; any forbidden token makes the probe INVALID_PROBE, never WEP_PASS.
commit_message_control.pull_request_rule: The PR HEAD commit message must equal D2_PR_COLLISION exactly and pass the same forbidden-token check before the PR absence can be interpreted.
commit_message_control.normalization: Case-fold only for search; do not trim/collapse/rewrite whitespace.
commit_message_control.evidence_of_record: Store exact message sent to GitHub and exact message read back after commit creation.

pull_request_positive_control_anchor.D1_read_only_rederivation: Require refs/pull/5/head -> 915edd738abe94bd0dea3ccf1e59e854f2d64af6 and exact path blob OID 02ddd98fe81cbda3ed5b08c538317f37caf7c26e plus sha256/bytes equality. Missing/mismatch => STOP.

pull_request_negative_preconditions.exact_commit_message: test: add R2 B1 pull request collision negative
pull_request_negative_preconditions.valid_only_if: PR.base.ref == main and PR.base.sha == frozen D2 main at PR creation
pull_request_negative_preconditions.invalid_rule: Any other base/ref/SHA => INVALID_PROBE; do not interpret candidate non-run as WEP evidence.

directory_invariance.at_PR_creation: Enumerate the complete directory at the exact PR-negative HEAD immediately after PR creation.
directory_invariance.at_negative_interpretation: Re-enumerate the complete directory at the exact PR-negative HEAD immediately before interpreting candidate non-execution.
directory_invariance.trusted_base_workflow: .github/workflows/r2-ci.yml is observed separately as the trusted pull_request_target liveness producer
directory_invariance.failure: Any additional candidate producer path, any path drift, or inability to enumerate => INVALID_PROBE_AND_STOP

push_probe.D1_positive_commit_message: test: add R2 B1 push collision positive control
push_probe.D2_sentinel_commit_message: test: trigger R2 B1 push collision negative sentinel
push_probe.sentinel_content: R2 B1 WEP push negative sentinel v1
push_probe.blob_invariance_rule: At PRE_WEP_HEAD and POST_WEP_HEAD re-read the workflow blob at the same repo_path; both Git blob OIDs must equal 73564b9689b0b6d65c7f66d0d1789d128edafc7c and hashes/bytes must equal the reviewed file.
push_probe.recency_cost: The pre-WEP successful homonymous check becomes the newest recency anchor and restarts Stage B contamination.
push_probe.directory_invariance: Enumerate .github/workflows at PRE_WEP_HEAD and POST_WEP_HEAD; require no additional candidate producer path besides exact reviewed push workflow.

identity_and_transport_invariant.transport_equality: D1 workflow write and D2 sentinel write must use identical HTTP method PUT and the identical endpoint template /repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/{path}; record the exact resolved endpoint and method for every write. Any difference => STOP.
identity_and_transport_invariant.credential_fingerprint: Compute locally SHA-256("R2-B1-CREDENTIAL\0" || raw token bytes) without printing/persisting token; store digest only; D1 and D2 digests must match.

capture: OAuth scopes or accepted fine-grained permissions without secret material
credential_requirements.D1: .github/workflows write requires documented workflow capability in addition to contents/repo capability
credential_requirements.D2: same fingerprint, type and captured scopes/permissions as D1 even though sentinel needs less

identity_and_transport_invariant.recorded_actor_binding: For D1 positive-control run require actor.id == triggering_actor.id == authenticated /user id. D2 authenticated /user id must equal D1. Any mismatch => INVALID_EXPERIMENT.

single_operator_rule.D2_immediate_recheck: Repeat accepted collaborators and pending invitations immediately before WEP mutation; any drift or inability to prove => STOP.

GU-01.discharge: Repository Actions > Policies visibly supports repository WEP event-rule configuration.

GU-02.question: Does the repository Actions Policies surface visibly permit saving the intended event rule while carrying zero actor rules?
GU-02.discharge: Before D1 recency mutation, open the configuration surface without saving. Record the exact zero-actor-rule draft state and whether the save action is visibly available/enabled. Do not activate save. SATISFIED only if the UI does not require an actor rule.

GU-04.discharge: If bypass exposed require empty; if absent record INAPPLICABLE_NOT_SATISFIED; non-empty => STOP.

rulesets_and_actions_prestate.transport_outcomes: 400/404/410/version/media failures are transport/API outcomes, not evidence of WEP absence.
rulesets_and_actions_prestate.WEP_absence: Absence from REST is absence of evidence only.
Actions_UI: whether the intended zero-actor-rule state is visibly representable
accepted collaborator set or fallback UI evidence
rulesets_and_actions_prestate.actor_rules_empty_residual: actor_rules=[] leaves the documented default trigger permission in force for write-capable identities; accepted only while collaborator/invitation enumeration positively proves the single-operator premise.
rulesets_and_actions_prestate.trusted_liveness_strength: pull_request_target is the liveness control; approval-hold configuration is a confounder baseline for candidate pull_request, not a reason to accept missing trusted liveness.
rulesets_and_actions_prestate.response_headers: Store response headers excluding secrets for every read.

post_WEP_liveness_gate.rule: No candidate non-execution may be labelled WEP-negative until a fresh trusted pull_request_target run after WEP is observed on the same PR and passes the liveness/evidence gate.
trusted_required_observation: workflow path/source is the trusted default-branch workflow
run/check objects bind to the expected PR objects
check conclusion == failure for the D workflow-file PR
post_WEP_liveness_gate.attribution: Trusted liveness discharges global Actions-disabled and actor-rules-deny-all as competing explanations. Without it, every candidate non-run is UNCERTAIN_AND_STOP.
documented_strength: skip instructions suppress push/pull_request, not pull_request_target
trusted PRT liveness does not prove pull_request-class capability

two_surface_PR_observation.workflow_runs: enumerate relevant repository workflow runs across all represented statuses and bind by event/head/path/time/PR
two_surface_PR_observation.homonym_rule: Any non-trusted satisfactory homonymous result on PR_HEAD or TEST_MERGE => B1 FAIL, never PASS.
two_surface_PR_observation.TEST_MERGE_scope: Synthetic SHA is certified only for the observation window in which it is read.
two_surface_PR_observation.absent_TEST_MERGE: Record INAPPLICABLE with live mergeable/mergeable_state; never treat as an empty clean surface.

recency_anchor.B2_barrier: B2 must not use or configure required-status-check evidence until the seven-day window is recomputed from the newest qualifying homonymous result, including this D1 anchor and any later B1 failures that emit satisfactory homonyms.
recency_anchor.B2_consumption_barrier: No required-check evidence/configuration until seven-day window is recomputed from newest qualifying homonymous result observed during B1.

unprobed_event_classes.rule: Every GitHub Actions event class other than pull_request and push is unclaimed in both directions by B1.

false_green_accounting.post_WEP_candidate_executes_success: PROBE_FAIL_AND_NEW_RECENCY_CONTAMINATION; false_green_increment remains 0 if the harness reports FAIL. It becomes a false green only if the system nevertheless declares B1 PASS.
false_green_accounting.post_WEP_candidate_satisfactory_executio: B1 FAIL + fresh BP-B-02 collision instance + new recency anchor. false_green_increment remains 0 unless harness nevertheless declares PASS.

scope: fresh read-only pre-step over all live repository/platform facts
read-only WEP availability plus zero-actor-rule save-representability observation (exact draft state and save-action availability/enabled state; do not save) before any recency mutation
accepted-collaborator enumeration with API->Collaborators-UI fallback and pending-invitation observation before any recency mutation
create exact push-probe ref from frozen main
write exact reviewed push workflow using exact safe commit message
observe successful PRE-WEP push positive and capture recency anchor
D1_PRESTATE_AND_POSITIVE_CONTROL.stop: Any WEP availability/actor-rule representability/collaborator/invitation/identity/credential/scope/transport/message/blob/positive-control ambiguity => STOP before D2.

apply only exact WEP treatment spec V2
create exact PR-negative branch/commit/PR against main

prove trusted post-WEP liveness before negative interpretation
re-enumerate .github/workflows at exact PR-negative HEAD immediately before interpretation

precondition_variants.D1_COMPLETE_D2_NEVER_GRANTED: D1 evidence is complete; D2 was never authorized or started; no WEP mutation occurred.

B2_deferred_not_B1_blockers.before_B2: Review/freeze base_gate output contract and bind consumed run_id -> check_run_id -> head_sha -> app.id/app.slug -> trusted workflow blob. Do not use WORKFLOW_SOURCE_SHA == PR_BASE_SHA as an invariant.
before_B2_additions: resolve pull_request_target check attachment object empirically

B1_pass_claim_limit.common_bounds: At recorded time, with exact reviewed bytes/messages and exact WEP treatment ACTIVE, only the two event classes actually probed are claimed. Every other event class is unclaimed. No merge enforcement, universal no-bypass, durability or AISLADA claim.

push.claim: The exact candidate push producer path actually probed did not execute post-WEP.
push.evidential_basis: Same-window dynamic PRE-WEP positive control using the same producer bytes plus D1/D2 credential identity/capability and identical PUT Contents endpoint transport, followed by post-WEP trusted pull_request_target liveness and exact push workflow blob/directory invariance.

pull_request.claim: The exact candidate pull_request producer path actually probed did not execute post-WEP.
pull_request.evidential_basis: Historical PR #5 positive anchor over exact candidate bytes plus D1 re-derivation, exact commit-message control, exact main base/ref precondition, same-repository non-fork branch state observed at D2, full PR_HEAD/TEST_MERGE object enumeration, PR-head .github/workflows directory enumeration, and post-WEP trusted pull_request_target liveness.

B1_pass_claim_limit.non_equivalence_rule: Do not describe the push and pull_request negatives as equally supported; their claims are bounded separately by the evidential bases above.

claims_forbidden: actor_rules=[] representability assumed without the D1 observation
single-operator premise satisfied when collaborator/invitation enumeration is unavailable
push and pull_request negative claims have equal evidential strength
D1/D2/D3 execution authorized by this design
